custom_preconds:
Organization has the ShopCoach feature flag enabled.
A custom role "WO View Only" exists (Work Orders: View ON; Work Order Lines Create & Edit: OFF) with a confirmed user.
At least one Work Order exists on the org.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the WO-View-Only user and open a Work Order's Lines tab.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Work Order detail renders (status badge visible); the in-page ShopCoach Line Builder panel (.shop-coach-line-builder) is NOT present.

custom_steps_separated.content: As the WO-View-Only user, if the New Line dialog is reachable, open it.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Build Lines button (data-test-id=button_shop_coach_line_builder) is NOT present (count 0).

title: ShopCoach Build Lines entry point hidden for Work-Orders-View-only role
